description: This file implements hardware-accelerated CRC32 computation optimized for Intel and ARM architectures, including classes and functions for CRC acceleration, SIMD usage, and multi-stream processing.

classes.name: CRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombined
classes.description: Class providing hardware-accelerated CRC32 functions for Intel and ARM architectures.

classes.name: CRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombinedMultipleStreams
classes.description: Template class for multi-stream CRC32 acceleration using SIMD and hardware instructions.

classes.name: CRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombinedMultipleStreamsBase
classes.description: Base class containing shared data and methods for multi-stream CRC32 acceleration.

methods.name: ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Extends CRC value by appending zeros efficiently using hardware acceleration.

methods.name: ComputeZeroConstant
methods.description: Computes a constant used to extend CRC by zeros via multiplication.

methods.name: Process64BytesPclmul
methods.description: Processes 64 bytes of data using PCLMULQDQ instructions for CRC acceleration.

methods.name: FinalizePclmulStream
methods.description: Reduces partial CRC vectors into a single CRC value.

methods.name: Process64BytesCRC
methods.description: Processes 64 bytes of data for CRC calculation.

methods.name: TryNewCRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombined
methods.description: Detects CPU type and returns an appropriate hardware-accelerated CRC implementation.

methods.name: NewCRC32AcceleratedX86ARMCombinedAll
methods.description: Creates a collection of all available hardware-accelerated CRC implementations.
